data.name: plan_exercises
constraints: CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
CHECK (reps_max IS NULL OR reps_max BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min <= reps_max)
CHECK (target_load_kg IS NULL OR target_load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600)

data.name: session_sets
constraints: CHECK (reps IS NULL OR reps BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
CHECK (load_kg IS NULL OR load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
CHECK (assistance_kg IS NULL OR assistance_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)
CHECK (average_heart_rate IS NULL OR average_heart_rate BETWEEN 30 AND 250)
CHECK (energy_provenance IS NULL OR energy_provenance IN ('userEntered', 'estimated'))
CHECK (exertion_value IS NULL OR exertion_value BETWEEN 0 AND 10)
CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "site" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "per100_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_servings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_log_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_meal" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_meal_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_meal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_meals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "portions" REAL NOT NULL, "prep_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "cook_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "storage" TEXT NULL, "freezing" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "reheating" TEXT NULL, "favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favourite" IN (0, 1)), "prep_steps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "cook_steps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "total_weight_g" REAL NULL, "portion_weight_g" REAL NULL, "declared_kcal" REAL NULL, "declared_protein_g" REAL NULL, "declared_carbs_g" REAL NULL, "declared_fat_g" REAL NULL, "declared_fibre_g" REAL NULL, "nutrition_note" TEXT NULL, "ingredient_notes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "serving_count" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_substitutes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_ingredient_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipe_ingredients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carbs_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fibre_g" REAL NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_plan_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "eaten_entry_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prep_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "prepared_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "portions_made" REAL NOT NULL, "portions_remaining" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("portions_remaining" >= 0.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscle" TEXT NOT NULL, "secondary_muscles_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "search_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "supplied" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("supplied" IN (0, 1)), "copied_from_id" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "split" TEXT NULL, "scheduled_weekdays_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps_min" INTEGER NULL, "reps_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_load_kg" REAL NULL, "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "target_metres" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sort_order >= 0), CHECK (target_sets BETWEEN 1 AND 20), CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (reps_max IS NULL OR reps_max BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK ((reps_min IS NULL) = (reps_max IS NULL)), CHECK (reps_min IS NULL OR reps_min <= reps_max), CHECK (target_load_kg IS NULL OR target_load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), CHECK (target_duration_sec IS NULL OR target_duration_sec > 0), CHECK (target_metres IS NULL OR target_metres > 0), CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (position >= 0), CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 4000));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "load_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "assistance_kg" REAL NULL, "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL, "metres" REAL NULL, "average_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NULL, "energy_provenance" TEXT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "exertion_scale" TEXT NULL, "exertion_value" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "set_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'working' CHECK (set_kind IN ('warmUp', 'working', 'failure')), "session_exercise_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (reps IS NULL OR reps BETWEEN 1 AND 100), CHECK (load_kg IS NULL OR load_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), CHECK (assistance_kg IS NULL OR assistance_kg BETWEEN 0 AND 1000), CHECK (duration_sec IS NULL OR duration_sec > 0), CHECK (metres IS NULL OR metres > 0), CHECK (average_heart_rate IS NULL OR average_heart_rate BETWEEN 30 AND 250), CHECK (energy_kcal IS NULL OR energy_kcal >= 0), CHECK (energy_provenance IS NULL OR energy_provenance IN ('userEntered', 'estimated')), CHECK ((energy_kcal IS NULL) = (energy_provenance IS NULL)), CHECK (exertion_value IS NULL OR exertion_value BETWEEN 0 AND 10), CHECK (rest_seconds IS NULL OR rest_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_workouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_day" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (origin IN ('date', 'weekday', 'split')), CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'skipped', 'done')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "training_splits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cycle_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (cycle_days BETWEEN 1 AND 14));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES training_splits (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (day_index BETWEEN 0 AND 13), UNIQUE (split_id, day_index));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_quarantine" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "quarantined_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "site" TEXT NULL, "target" REAL NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_measurements_site_recorded ON measurements (site, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_foods_barcode ON foods (barcode)
CREATE INDEX idx_foods_search_key ON foods (search_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_servings_food ON food_servings (food_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_food_log_day ON food_log_entries (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_meal_items_meal ON saved_meal_items (saved_meal_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_ingredients_recipe ON recipe_ingredients (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recipe_substitutes_ingredient ON recipe_substitutes (recipe_ingredient_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_meal_plan_items_day ON meal_plan_items (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_prep_batches_recipe ON prep_batches (recipe_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_plan_exercises_plan ON plan_exercises (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_sessions_started ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_session ON session_sets (session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_exercise ON session_sets (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_entry ON session_sets (session_exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_workouts_day ON scheduled_workouts (day)
CREATE INDEX idx_split_days_split ON split_days (split_id)
